# Corvus Star (CStar)

> **Legacy archive:** CStar is no longer the active Corvus control plane or
> workflow router. Corvus Organism owns current authority and orchestration.
> This source is retained for preservation, migration, and bounded diagnostics;
> do not install or activate it for normal estate work.

## Archive status

- The implementation, tests, and historical contracts remain available for
  audit and migration.
- `.mcp.json`, the Gemini materialization, and the Codex plugin materialization
  are inert compatibility tombstones. They register no MCP server, skill,
  hook, marketplace install, or write capability.
- CStar databases, registries, receipts, and callbacks are historical evidence,
  not authority and not current lifecycle state.
- Host-local databases and configuration are intentionally excluded from Git.

## Development-only validation

Use Node.js 24 LTS (supported range `>=22 <26`) and the locked dependencies.
These checks validate preserved source; they do not activate CStar:

```bash
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run typecheck
npm run validate:distributions
npm run test:node
npm run test:python
```

The repository CI includes macOS, Linux, and Windows portability coverage.
Installation, activation, restart, deployment, production, and publication are
separate operator-gated states and are not part of archive validation.
